comparison_caveat: The all-picks hypothetical is restricted to games with saved, verified pre-tipoff prices. Unpriced games are excluded, not assigned invented odds or zero-profit bets. Each settled hypothetical bet risks 1% of its simulated bankroll, compounded in scheduled tipoff order. It does not model the actual strategy's 5% concurrent exposure limit or real-time bet availability. This is an illustrative counterfactual, not a directly equivalent execution backtest.
